item.title: KDHE launches travel and health web page
item.description: TOPEKA — The Kansas Department of Health and Environment (KDHE) has launched a new Travel and Health webpage to provide healthcare and public health partners with educational and clinical resources ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026TM.

item.title: KDOT promotes Hearne in District Six
item.description: The Kansas Department of Transportation recently promoted Travis Hearne as District Six Maintenance Superintendent for Area 3. He replaces Galen Ludlow, who was promoted to District Six Maintenance Manager.
